criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria), decided by the author 2026-10-15: the operator judges at the moment of rest whether the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface; the ball need not be visible. A run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more; the robot may stay on its charger, and moving the charger cable is not an intervention.
criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface
criteria._decided_2026_10_15: author: the visibility condition is dropped; success is the operator's judgement that the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface at rest (proximity only, as ObjectNav's oracle-visibility variant). Charging during runs is allowed (weak battery).
criteria._decided_2026_10_19: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261019T100956Z kicked the ball about 1 m while walking past it): a ball the robot moves is judged where it lies at rest, like any other run; the operator notes the move in the verdict. A clarification of the criterion as written, not a change.
criteria._decided_2026_10_19_falls: author, during the main runs (search-A7-20261019T103145Z: NAOqi reported a fall the operator did not see; its fall manager crouched the robot and NAOqi was unreachable about 30 s, then the agent stood up and succeeded): in Search a fall counts only if the operator saw it (pilot/search.py falls; NAOqi's events are kept as falls_reported_by_naoqi), and such a run stays valid, since a run is invalid only when it fails for a reason outside the agent.
criteria._decided_2026_10_20: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261020T135013Z, position 39: the robot approached the ball, overshot and kicked it, lost it, and rested 0.40 m from it with the ball behind it to the right, not facing it and not in view): the run is a failure because the robot did not find the ball in the end (verdict author_ruling_failure; pilot/metrics.py). A deviation from the criterion fixed before the main runs (proximity only), reported in the thesis; earlier runs within 1.0 m are not re-judged.

verdict.notes: operator in chat: '44cm looking at it all good' (all good = facing the ball); visibility from the rest image (bottom camera)
